say:1:1220244001:0.text: Pull it harder! Yank it off with all your might!

say:5:1220244002:0.text: Heh, this steel pipe is a gem compared to those rusty relics we had before!
say:5:1220244002:0.source_cn: 哈，这根钢管不错，不像前头那几根破烂，全锈坏了！

say:6:1220244003:0.text: A mermaid's hex upon you! You're back trying to steal my pipes again?!

say:7:1220244004:1.text: It's because of you lot that my shop always runs out of water, ain't it? You think I won't feed you to the sharks?!
say:7:1220244004:1.source_cn: 就是你们害我的店老是断水？信不信老子送你们去喂鲨鱼！

say:8:1220244005:1.text: There's a water shortage anyway. The water's foul, no one drinks it!
say:8:1220244005:1.source_cn: 不就是断水吗？反正水又不好喝，根本没人喝水！

say:9:1220244006:1.text: Y-yeah! Drinking ale is fine! Water is pricey and... *hiccup*... tastes terrible...
say:9:1220244006:1.source_cn: 反、反、反正喝酒，喝酒就行了！水……又贵，又，嗝，难喝！

say:12:1220244007:1.text: This pipe's already rusted through. No one would want it even if it's just lying around. What's wrong with us playing with it?
say:12:1220244007:1.source_cn: 你这管子早就烂了，丢路边都没人要……我们拿去玩玩怎么了？

say:13:1220244008:1.text: Are you out of your minds? Do you know who you're talking to?
say:13:1220244008:1.source_cn: 胡言乱语的混蛋，脑子都被酒泡坏了吧，你们知道在和谁说话吗？

say:16:1220244009:1.text: These guys reek of booze. They must've been drinking during the day again...
say:16:1220244009:1.source_cn: 这些家伙身上一股酒气，又在大白天喝酒了吧……

say:17:1220244010:1.text: Ah, I remember you now! The odd bunch with the talking hamsters!
say:17:1220244010:1.source_cn: 啊，我记得你们几个！怪模怪样的家伙和仓鼠！

say:18:1220244011:1.text: I let you off last time because of Walter, but why'd you bring some shorty this time?
say:18:1220244011:1.source_cn: 上回看在沃尔特的面子上饶你们一回，怎么这次又带了个矮子来？

say:21:1220244012:1.text: Shorty? Who are you calling short?! You're going to regret this!
say:21:1220244012:1.source_cn: 矮子？！你说谁矮子呢？！没礼貌的家伙，需要吃点苦头！

say:22:1220244013:1.text: Hmph, perfect time to test out this new pipe I got!
say:22:1220244013:1.source_cn: 哼，正好试试新到手的家伙好不好使！
